meaning_first.independence_note: Fresh reviewer context. The blind packet was built from the author's original bytes and the findings were written to content/reviews/092-review.md before opening the full batch, starters or notes. tone_balance.scope_note: All eight sources are ordinary everyday scenes; the cat joke in buurman-vakantie lives in the model answer only. The small-batch cap is ceil(8 x 0.15) = 2, so the batch is within range; the coordinator checks the combined A2 program count.

meaning.situation_summary: The writer goes on holiday for two weeks in July, neighbour Kerem will visit daily, and the writer leaves a key and a note; three drawings show him feeding a grey cat, taking post from the mat and watering tomato plants on a balcony.
meaning.communicative_purpose: Tell Kerem the three chores shown, so the house, cat and plants are looked after while the writer is away.
meaning.contrivance_check: The prompt gives the holiday, the key and the daily visits; the pictures give the chores. Kerem is the actor in the pictures, so no message to a person beside the writer; the cat is inferred from the pictures, not assumed.
meaning.medium_and_recipient_check: A note with the key in the neighbour's letterbox is exactly how such a favour is arranged; "Hoi Kerem ... Groetjes" matches an informal neighbour.

media_notes: Only buurman-vakantie has pictures: three separate drawings of one man (a man of about forty with short black hair and a blue jumper) copied verbatim in all briefs; one clear action each (feeding the grey cat, picking up blank envelopes from the mat, watering tomato plants with a green watering can); no text requested. Contact-sheet check should confirm the envelopes read as post on a mat and the tomatoes are clearly red.
limitations: AI editorial review does not validate CEFR difficulty or official exam equivalence.

Level verdicts are editorial comparisons with existing catalogue items of the same task type, not learner data.
